verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents several built-in AI features that take on specific tasks. The AI Editor builds and edits ingestion workflows from natural-language prompts, Sprinto AI validates uploaded evidence and flags gaps, and the platform offers AI-assisted due diligence reviews. These are narrow, feature-scoped AI functions rather than a general in-product assistant you can hand arbitrary tasks to. The GitHub compliance skills run in external coding agents, so they are not credited as built-in. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product AI assistant or agent for delegating arbitrary compliance tasks, documentation of its scope and actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
